title: Add the accepted WD-001 weight-decay result to the shared status page, DECISIONS.md, RESEARCH_STATUS.md and the draft write-up
description: User request (2026-11-27, 'Yes, update them'). WD-001 (accepted after REVIEW-014; selection lock WD-001S accepted after REVIEW-013; both reviews cross-reviewed) answered COORD-004 D's open question 'whether a weight-decay-tuned wide head would match the MSE head' and re-tested the CE-only wide head of COORD-004 C's ABL-001 row. Edit in place, per the harness supersession rule (this task's submission supersedes the earlier holders' copies): (1) ai_harness/artifacts/COORD-004/status.md (revision 2): a new B5 with W1-W4 and the caveats; the ABL-001 and compression-tolerance rows of section C; section D (weight-decay item answered; new open items: sparse-CE possibly under-trained, AdamW/decay scope untested); errata for slips found in REVIEW-013/REVIEW-014 and their cross-reviews (WD-001 report wording points O-1..O-5 and 'no detected change' in compression cost; REVIEW-013 submission note); process notes (WD-001A refused entry, overnight stop and rerun); a revision log entry. (2) ai_harness/artifacts/WRITE-001/report_draft.md (revision 3): a new results subsection for WD-001, matching edits to methods (pre-registration list, settings not re-tuned), limitations, conclusion, the tolerance box and Appendix B; revision log entry. (3) DECISIONS.md: a dated 'Update, 2026-11-27' section above 'Current state, 2026-11-26' and a change-log entry. (4) RESEARCH_STATUS.md: a dated 2026-11-27 update at the top; earlier updates kept as history. Use REVIEW-014's corrected wording (sparse top-5 and training-level gaps larger than dense; sparse gap 'about the same' at every level; 'no detected change' in compression cost, not 'no change'; sparse conclusion within the grid and 20-epoch budget). No experiments, no new numbers beyond WD-001's analysis.md/analysis.json and the accepted reviews, no edits to src/, done reports, the proposal or the bibliography. WORK_SUMMARY.md is updated by the coordinator outside this task.
acceptance: Every WD-001 number matches WD-001 analysis.md/analysis.json or REVIEW-014

Nothing stated more strongly than the accepted WD-001 report as corrected by REVIEW-014 and the cross-reviews (W1 below tolerance and outside the pre-declared readings; W2 within the grid and 20-epoch budget; sparse-CE may be under-trained)
Earlier content preserved; changes recorded in each file's revision or change log
harness.py check passes with the earlier copies of status.md, report_draft.md, DECISIONS.md and RESEARCH_STATUS.md superseded
